name: Hikage de Sukusuku
source:
In 2045, the declining television industry goes on a rampage by broadcasting radical programs.
The name of the program is “In the shade”
At first glance, I thought it was an educational program about a girl observing mushrooms in a natural park, but the mushroom turned out to be a man named ○○○.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ097577.html/]DLsite[/url]]
